summary: Associated Banc-Corp filed an 8-K announcing the planned retirement of EVP, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary Randall J. Erickson, effective October 13, 2026, after 14+ years, with advisory support through year-end. Angela M.W. Kelley, age 45, will succeed him, bringing 20 years of experience, most recently as CEO of Diversity Lab/Talent Multipliers, previously at Heartland Financial and PacWest. This is a pre-announced, orderly succession, not a forced departure. The retirement date and appointment are set, with transition support ensuring continuity. What to watch is a smooth handoff of legal and corporate secretary duties.
